items.quote: First of all, I own a 2008 Toyota 4Runner with 300k miles on it. Jason arrived on time and was very professional and cordial. He immediately went to work and spent over 3 hours meticulously cleaning it in every way.

Jason is wonderful! My Acadia looks better than the detail job the dealership did before I bought it and he was very accommodating to a last minute unexpected change in my schedule. Well worth the money.

I recently had my vehicle detailed and had the pleasure of working with Jason, who did an outstanding job. From start to finish, he was professional, attentive to detail, and clearly takes pride in his work.
Jason is incredibly thorough and did a great job with our van and car. Highly recommend!
